description: This file defines a React component 'MyBooks' which manages and displays a user's collection of books, including different reading statuses and views (list or shelf). It handles fetching data from API endpoints, toggling views, and rendering UI components such as BookList and ShelfView.

classes.name: MyBooks
classes.description: A React component that manages and displays a user's book collection with different views and statuses.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component's state and binds methods.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches initial data and sets up device size tracking.

methods.name: getReadBooks
methods.description: Fetches books marked as read from the API.

methods.name: getDidNotFinishBooks
methods.description: Fetches books not finished from the API.

methods.name: toReadBooks
methods.description: Fetches books to read from the API.

methods.name: readingBooks
methods.description: Fetches currently reading books from the API.

methods.name: getBooks
methods.description: Fetches all books from the API.

methods.name: onAddShelf
methods.description: Opens the modal to add a new shelf.

methods.name: trackCurrentDeviceSize
methods.description: Sets up window resize listener to toggle list view based on device width.

methods.name: onToggleListView
methods.description: Toggles between list and shelf views.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including navigation, book display, and controls.
